description: This file implements the Cauchy distribution class as part of the Apache Commons Math library, providing statistical functions such as density, cumulative probability, and inverse cumulative probability for the distribution.

classes.name: CauchyDistribution
classes.description: Represents the Cauchy distribution, providing methods for its probability density, cumulative distribution, inverse cumulative distribution, and distribution parameters.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the cumulative distribution function at a given point x.

methods.name: getMedian
methods.description: Returns the median parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Returns the scale parameter of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the probability density function at a given point x.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the cumulative distribution function for a probability p.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the numerical mean of the distribution, which is always NaN for Cauchy.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the numerical variance of the distribution, always NaN.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support, always negative infinity.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support, always positive infinity.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the lower bound of support is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates if the upper bound of support is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Returns true indicating the support is connected.
